title: Differentially Private Distribution Release of Gaussian Mixture Models via KL-Divergence Minimization
abstract: arXiv:2506.03467v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) are widely used statistical models for representing multi-modal data distributions, with numerous applications in data mining, pattern recognition, data simulation, and machine learning. However, recent research has shown that releasing GMM parameters poses significant privacy risks, potentially exposing sensitive information about the underlying data. In this paper, we address the challenge of releasing GMM parameters while ensuring differential privacy (DP) guarantees. Specifically, we focus on the privacy protection of mixture weights, component means, and covariance matrices. We propose to use Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence as a utility metric to assess the accuracy of the released GMM, as it captures the joint impact of noise perturbation on all the model parameters. translated_title: 基于KL散度最小化的高斯混合模型差分隐私分布发布
translated_abstract: 高斯混合模型（GMM）是广泛用于表示多模态数据分布的统计模型，在数据挖掘、模式识别、数据模拟和机器学习等领域有众多应用。然而，近期研究表明，发布GMM参数存在显著的隐私风险，可能暴露底层数据中的敏感信息。本文研究了在确保差分隐私（DP）保证的前提下发布GMM参数这一挑战。具体而言，我们专注于混合权重、分量均值和协方差矩阵的隐私保护。我们提出使用Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度作为效用度量来评估所发布GMM的准确性，因为它能够捕捉噪声扰动对所有模型参数的联合影响。我们开发了一个以KL散度驱动的差分隐私GMM发布优化框架，联合设计隐私……
tldr: 本文提出了一种以KL散度为效用度量驱动的优化框架，在差分隐私保证下发布高斯混合模型的混合权重、分量均值和协方差矩阵，以防止底层数据敏感信息的泄露。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a KL-divergence-driven optimization framework for the differentially private release of Gaussian Mixture Model parameters, jointly protecting mixture weights, component means, and covariance matrices to prevent leakage of sensitive underlying data.
